answer: Cedar rings: an identity's weight grows only with consecutive epochs of liveliness — one ring per unbroken epoch, and a missed epoch fells the tree back to sapling. A sybil army is born weightless and must be watered every epoch to matter, so the attacker's cost scales with identities × time, not identities alone. Each ring carries a pigment — the prior epoch's seed words woven into the answer — forming a trail; identical pigment trails across identities expose clones, and the orchard prunes any tree whose answers grade junk, shedding rings faster than they grow.
